name: Royal Gallery
summary: In Stormwind Keep, the Royal Gallery honors the kingdom’s history and the Grand Alliance. Beyond the courtyard garden, a quiet hall holds statues and works of art.

sections.title: A Hall of Heroes
sections.body: Beyond the interior garden and beside the Royal Library, the Royal Gallery holds statues of King Llane Wrynn, Stormwind’s fallen ruler, and Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras. Lady Mara Fordragon is honored here too, for her patronage of the refugees who fled to Lordaeron after the First War. Courtly visitors such as Lady Dena Kennedy come to see these figures and the works of art around them.

faq.q: Where is the Royal Gallery located?
aliases: how to get to royal gallery
faq.answer: The Royal Gallery lies inside Stormwind Keep, beyond the small interior courtyard park and beside the Royal Library.

faq.q: Which historical figures are commemorated here?
faq.answer: King Llane Wrynn, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and Lady Mara Fordragon are commemorated with statues honoring the kingdom and its closest allies.

faq.q: Who can be found visiting the gallery?
faq.answer: Lady Dena Kennedy visits the gallery to admire its art and quiet atmosphere.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Royal Gallery and the Royal Library?
aliases: is it part of the library
faq.answer: The Royal Gallery and the Royal Library are separate chambers beside each other in Stormwind Keep’s royal wing. The library holds royal archives and scholars, while the gallery displays fine art and memorial sculpture.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the gallery honors the sacrifices of its people and leaders such as Daelin Proudmoore and King Llane.
As a human of Stormwind, you can see House Wrynn and House Fordragon’s heritage honored within the keep.
